about: v0.9.0 VX V45 (VFX_AUDIT.md; PLAN C83: every texture through an id with a code fallback): every effect texture id the code asks for in assets/textures/vfx/, what it is for, how it is tinted, and what draws when it is missing. status: installed (the PNG is here; its hash is in assets/models/manifest.json) or fallback (not delivered: the fallback draws). tint: multiply (a white or greyscale sheet tinted by the code's colour), mask (L how white-hot, A coverage, tinted between two colours), art (the owner's colours, multiplied by a near-white), decal (a floor mark's albedo). tests/content/test_vfx_manifest.gd keeps it whole both ways. The requests are docs/art/requests/v0.9.0_ART_LIST.md §7 and §7c.
